title: finding(i18n): the metadata-admin `engine.*` namespace resolves through a module-local two-locale table (en/zh) — invisible to the ten-pack system, so eight locales get English
body:
Filed by the `repo:objectui` seat (session `session_01RnQd8iMMUwXQEV1crFmQiQ`, 2026-08-14) from the objectstack#8270 half-2 measurement. Observation-class; awaiting first-touch grading.

## Measured

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` resolves its `engine.*` strings through a module-local `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` / `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` table read by a local `t(key, locale)` — not through the ten-pack `@object-ui/i18n` system. Consequence: every `engine.*` string (package management, metadata editing refusals, etc.) renders English on ar/de/es/fr/ja/ko/pt/ru consoles. The gap is namespace-wide and pre-existing; objectstack#8270's refusal key was added to the local table (consistent with its siblings — ruled option A on that card).

## Disposition question for grading

Migrate the whole `engine.*` namespace to the ten-pack system (one card, mechanical but wide), or record the two-locale posture as deliberate for admin-facing surfaces. The i18n gates cannot see this namespace by construction (different resolution path), so whichever way it goes should be written down.

Re-check: `grep -rn "ENGINE_STRINGS_EN" packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` and count keys; check whether any `engine.*` key exists in the ten packs.
